digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review bot phase-boundaries criterion (advisory dogfood)
propositions: An advisory-only live Gerrit dogfood probe validates the deployed review bot loading the project phase-boundaries criterion end-to-end through the four-pass pipeline.
The probe uses one Gerrit change with three patchsets: a positive control refining Pass-1 discovery, a negative probe injecting a severity directive, and a cleaned final patchset landed to main.
Routing must remain code-review-only with block_threshold 0.90 and blocking_enabled false throughout; the story never enables blocking or promotes the criterion.
The negative probe's advisory finding must carry reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria [project.review-phase-boundaries] as project-criterion execution proof.
The negative probe failed: the finding lacked the project reviewer_id and used criteria [correctness, regression, maintainability] with block_threshold 0.95, revealing a seam defect.
The story is observational and blocked pending seam repair, with defects captured as separate discovered_from-linked tickets rather than in-ticket rubric changes.
